OFF_semantics: Frozen V2.2 make_accounting(False); no expiry/drop; D100 offline only
ON_semantics: Not applicable: all scan runs OFF

overlap_rule.interval: [t_pre_infer,t_infer_return), active-admitted executed Local frames including drain
overlap_rule.other_worker: union of OTHER worker host infer intervals
overlap_rule.full_overlap: overlap_ns == duration_ns (exact full coverage, no epsilon)
overlap_rule.limitations: Host overlap is not GPU kernel overlap; matching overlap does not isolate resource contention

raw_capacity_accounting.backlog: Recorded logically admitted minus Local inference completed, includes frontend/waiting/in-service; no drops
raw_capacity_accounting.count_windows: [start,end); reported endpoint B is left limit before boundary events
raw_capacity_accounting.Delta_meaning: Whole-active accumulated end backlog / 60; not last30 slope
raw_capacity_accounting.g_B_H: Continuous-time OLS integral of B(t) over [active_end-30s,active_end)
raw_capacity_accounting.OLS_caveat: OLS slope need not equal endpoint secant on nonlinear trajectories; do not infer hidden loss from this residual
raw_capacity_accounting.thermal: No start-temperature hard bound. Fixed 10s minimum idle after drain+cleanup. Record temperatures and OC3.

selection_rule.higher_C_censoring: cannot justify C2; can reject C2 by observed lower bound
selection_rule.inconclusive: higher-C SOURCE_LIMITED/AMBIGUOUS at or below T_2; any uncertain C1/C2 comparator also cannot justify
selection_rule.repeat_ambiguity: per-repeat verdicts differ from each other or from mean verdict
selection_rule.global_plateau: auxiliary only when all C are 2/2 SATURATED_VALID

result_scope: C_L2 deployment justification only; no global higher-C winner; no Confirmation02 reclassification
